description: This file defines a Flask route for a health check endpoint, using Flask-Smorest's Blueprint and Flask's MethodView to handle HTTP GET requests for a health check.

classes.name: HealthCheck
classes.description: A Flask view class handling GET requests for the root URL, returning a health status message.

methods.name: get(self)
methods.description: Handles GET requests to the health check endpoint, returning a JSON message indicating the system is healthy.
